[[File:Grimy guam leaf detail.png|left|170px]]
A '''grimy guam leaf''' is a [[herb]] that can be cleaned, requiring 3 [[Herblore]], and yielding a [[guam leaf]] and 2.5 Herblore [[experience]].

Grimy guam leaves can be harvested from [[herb patch]]es after planting a [[guam seed]], requiring 9 [[Farming]].

Guam leaves are used to make [[Attack potion]]s, [[Guthix rest]]s, and [[guam tar]].

A grimy guam leaf spawns in the [[Deep Wilderness Dungeon]].

When cleaned, the message {{Mes|You clean the Grimy guam leaf.}} is displayed.
